recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結被許多大小不一、邊界清楚、彼此緊密相鄰的淡粉紅色上皮樣肉芽腫取代，中央無壞死，周圍是深藍色的淋巴球，這種「裸露」（naked）非乾酪性肉芽腫是類肉瘤（sarcoidosis）的典型低倍影像。
features: Numerous well-formed, discrete to confluent granulomas of varying size replacing much of the lymph node
Granulomas composed of pale eosinophilic epithelioid histiocytes, sharply demarcated with only a thin lymphocytic rim ('naked' granulomas)
No central caseous necrosis in any granuloma
Occasional multinucleated giant cells discernible within granulomas (e.g., upper center)
Intervening residual dark-blue lymphoid tissue between granulomas
describe_en: Lymph node section at low power shows extensive replacement of the parenchyma by numerous, closely packed, well-circumscribed granulomas of variable size. The granulomas are composed of pale epithelioid histiocytes with occasional multinucleated giant cells and have a scant lymphocytic cuff, with residual lymphoid tissue in between. No caseous necrosis is identified. Findings are consistent with non-necrotizing granulomatous lymphadenitis, compatible with sarcoidosis after exclusion of mycobacterial and fungal infection by special stains and culture.

ddx.vs: Tuberculous granulomas are less uniform, frequently coalesce around central caseous necrosis, and may show AFB-positive organisms.
Toxoplasmosis shows small, ill-defined epithelioid histiocyte clusters encroaching on reactive follicles with monocytoid B-cell hyperplasia, not large discrete confluent granulomas.
Cat-scratch granulomas are stellate and suppurative with central neutrophilic microabscesses.
Hodgkin lymphoma contains Reed-Sternberg/Hodgkin cells (CD30+, CD15+) in a mixed inflammatory background between granulomas.
